definitions.explanation: A person who has reached maturity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早|はや}く→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧{大人|おとな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}りたい→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: I used to want to grow up quickly, but now I want to go back to being a child.

notes:
{大人|おとな} means adult and is used both literally (a grown person) and figuratively (mature, sensible behavior). The reading おとな is irregular — the kanji would normally read だいじん or たいじん.

USAGE:
{大人|おとな} often implies maturity and composure beyond just age. Saying {大人|おとな}だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ can mean "that's mature of you" as a compliment.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大人|おとな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to grow up, to become an adult
- {大人|おとな}⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧: mature, adult-like
- {大人|おとな}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: adult price/fare
- ⟦{大人|おとな}しい→大人しい：02339_otonashii⟧: gentle, well-behaved (a separate word, not directly related)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大人|おとな}: adult (general)
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧: child
- ⟦{成人|せいじん}→成人：03378_seijin⟧: adult in the legal sense (used in ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧, coming-of-age ceremony)
- ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧: young person
- お⟦{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧: elderly person
